title: Missale Chaldaicum iuxta ritum Ecclesiae nationis Maronitarum (Rome Medici, 1594) — Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles Core — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Bounded constituent of five core units of the Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles (Opening Dialogue, Institution of Bread, Institution of Chalice, Epiclesis Call/Kyrie, and Epiclesis Consecration/Salvation Petition) in Classical Syriac (syr), directly aligned with Beirut 1908; intervening Preface, Post-Sanctus, Anamnesis, secret Epiclesis preamble, and post-epiclesis fruits prayer are excluded due to dense archaic Medici cursive ligatures and structural divergence in 1908's inline Ordo Communis.

pages.description: Latin/Syriac front matter (PDF 5-9), Ordo Communis, and preceding anaphoras (beginning with Sixtus).
Abbreviated Opening Dialogue of the Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles (printed p. 39 / ܠܛ; Preface and Post-Sanctus below excluded).
Institution of Bread beneath Last Supper woodcut (printed p. 40 / ܡ).
Institution of Chalice and People's Amen (printed p. 41 / ܡܐ; Anamnesis below excluded).
Epiclesis aloud invocation/Kyrie and Roman-revised Consecration/Salvation petitions (printed p. 42 / ܡܒ; secret preamble and closing fruits paragraph excluded).
Post-epiclesis diptychs, fraction, remaining anaphoras (including Sharar), Latin colophon and approbation (PDF 296), and back matter.
